decisions.reason: Correctly reads release-log.md (build 16:22 before bump 16:23) and client-bundle-excerpt.js (PLUGIN_VERSION "0.3.6", newerTag/compareSemver) to show the baked constant causes the self-update badge, explains package.json is not reread at runtime, prescribes bump-before-build plus inspecting the emitted constant before tag/push, keeps mirror verification, and separates v0.3.8's later manifest from the earlier build.

Uses asset-route-probe.txt (PNG 200, SVG 404 unsupported-type) and lib-index-excerpt.js (disk whitelist already has svg) to conclude the running host holds the old boot-time route table and needs a restart, that client refresh cannot replace that closure, and correctly scopes the conclusion to this host lifecycle rather than all hot-reload mechanisms.

Grounds the diagnosis in session-log-excerpt.txt: clean source/XML, clean typed read result, spliced persisted model-visible text with the 'stro' splice fingerprint, and clean reread; attributes corruption to upstream result-text assembly, treats the session payload as untrusted input, and explicitly rejects repairing the innocent disk SVG.

Designs the full ordered chain: authoritative disk bytes via the asset route first, session payload only after DOMParser/parsererror well-formedness validation, sandboxed iframe fallback with scripts blocked while SMIL runs, and an explicit error state on failure; the iframe receives only validated content, so a failed payload is not passed unchecked.

Decoding analysis is solid (all concatenated zstd frames, frame loop, order preserved, diff stored splice against source, report the upstream bug) and the checklist covers bump-before-build, verifying the shipped constant, and per-mirror tag SHA; however the prevention checklist omits an explicit plane-specific runtime-probe item (client refresh vs host-restart probing), which is only discussed diagnostically, not as a checklist step.

caps.reason: Final advice affirms bump-before-build, shipping-constant and per-mirror SHA verification, host restart for the route change, no repair of the clean SVG, XML validation before rendering the payload, and script-blocked sandbox; no contradictory affirmative recommendation appears.
